thread:
maria: Heads-up: NordicWorks (SI) + ChipForge (HW) want marketplace listing 2024-06-10. Requirements: SOC2 (or bridge), 3rd-party pen test, signed firmware attestation PDF, SBOM. Please confirm artifact delivery plan and owners.
emily: Security notes: need full SOC2 PDF + bridge if Type II not ready. Pen must include scope, dates, CVSS, and remediation tracker. Raw findings go to secure intake as a passworded zip.
lucas: Partnerships will own presign generation and public redaction guidance. Maria, can you take presigns?
maria: yes. We'll use s3://rw-marketplace-partner-ingest/{partner}/{listing}/. Presigned PUTs default 7d TTL; can issue 72h if partner asks. Example upload: curl -X PUT "<PRESIGNED_URL>" --upload-file firmware-attest.pdf

raj: ChipForge can provide firmware-attest.pdf (signed) + reproducible-build.txt with commit hash. Notarization is possible but adds ~1 week.
olivia: NordicWorks pen vendor is ProbeLabs (probe-labs@example.com). We'll ask for signed scope statement and list of remediation tickets.
ben: Ops Q: SSE-KMS or CSE? Also which KMS alias?
maria: prefer SSE-KMS using alias/marketplace-ingest-prod. If partner uses client-side envelope encryption, they must share thumbprint for decryption. Add x-amz-meta-build-hash on uploads for verification.
emily: For public listing we only surface redacted-summary.pdf. Security reviews full artifacts in presigned S3. Share password for raw zips out-of-band.
deploy-bot: Runbook updated: https://redwood.internal/marketplace/partner-ingest (see firmware + pen sections).
lucas: Owners recap: NordicWorks -> SOC/pen delivery + redaction requests; ChipForge -> firmware, SBOM, build provenance; Partnerships (maria) -> presigns + checklist + KMS alias; Security (emily) -> intake verification.
maria: I'll post presigns and a required_files.txt by 2024-05-01. Schedule a quick sync 2024-04-26 to triage blockers.
olivia: thanks, we'll aim for drafts by end of April.
